text:
Felix: just opened a tiny PR to the 429/troubleshooting doc—adds a short KV-cache troubleshooting checklist, a concise SDK snippet (stream-safe), and fixes a bad link to the snippets index. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/pull/1782
Anya: sweet. can you include one explicit rule for readers: "try prefix-resume first; use short replay only when prefix miss or for strict determinism"? keeps it actionable.
Felix: added that line as a bold callout. also included a two-row decision bullet: Prefix-first = low latency/cost; Short replay = stronger consistency at token cost.
Rex: sketch a stream-safe snippet that avoids double-output if we need a replay. keep it language-agnostic pseudocode.
Felix: pasted this quick pseudo that we can adapt to Python/JS later:
```
# stream with kv prefix + short overlap replay on 429 (pseudo)
prefix = kv.load(session_key)
try:
  stream = client.stream_generate(prompt, kv_prefix=prefix)
  for chunk in stream:
    emit(chunk.text)
    prefix.last_idx = chunk.last_idx
except TooManyRequests:
  # ask for a small replay window overlapping a few tokens
  start = max(0, prefix.last_idx - 5)
  resp = client.generate(prompt, kv_range=(start, prefix.last_idx), max_tokens=48)
  # drop overlap chars that were already emitted
  emit(resp.text[prefix.overlap_chars:])
```
Marta: docs-ci: linkcheck failed on an OSS anchor -> https://github.com/redwood/sdks#old-snippet-anchor 404.
docs-ci: linkcheck error, failing PR check.
Anya: we moved that anchor to /sdks/usage#snippets-graceful-fallback earlier this quarter. update the link and CI should clear.
Felix: updated the anchor and added a parenthetical about context-window trimming: "If truncation removes required context, prefer replay but keep max_tokens conservative and validate output."
Rex: nit: explain overlap_chars in the snippet comment (it's the number of characters already emitted from the cached replay window).
Felix: added that clarifying parenthetical. also added a short note about telemetry: mark replay/speculative requests so teams can track token spend.
Marta: re-running linkcheck... now passes. rerun spellcheck just to be safe.
